title: Shepherds and Humility
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Peter closes his letter to a tired, pressured church and does not call for a harder push. He calls for a lower bow. Leaders shepherd the flock of God by going first, everyone ties on humility like a servant's apron, and right inside that call Peter says to throw every anxiety onto God, because He cares for you. The enemy only prowls like a lion; the Lion of the tribe of Judah has already conquered. And the last word of the letter is a promise: the God of all grace will Himself restore, confirm, strengthen and establish you.
subtitle: 1 and 2 Peter Week 5
